summary: Approved after the combined scanner was narrowed to an immutable typed canonical-YAML AST boundary, the CI scalar was quoted, and dependency installation plus execution were isolated and content-pinned.

findings.summary: An unquoted pip option colon made the candidate CI workflow invalid YAML.
The combined scanner discarded scalar types and accepted unvalidated GitHub schema fields; scope was split and this slice now preserves typed scalar style without making a schema or producer claim.
Non-isolated pip or module resolution could select repository shadow modules; install and execution now require -I and load the exact force-reinstalled hashed wheel origin.

limitations: This slice proves canonical typed YAML AST construction from B1 immutable Git blobs only; GitHub schema validity, expression/event/job semantics, producer availability, conditional and duplicate-context policy, inventory equality, active-workflow identity, and ruleset activation remain later slices. Remote Ubuntu must reproduce the suite without the Windows symlink privilege skip.
